newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 70.1 bln marks in repos at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 70.1 bln marks in repos at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 70.1 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent.

The central bank accepted 36.25 percent of the bids for the 14-day funds. A repo pact for 69.9 billion marks at a fixed 3.00 percent expires today, Wednesday, so a net 200 million marks is flowing into the money market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 193.5 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The repo rate has been fixed at 3.00 percent since late August.
